name: 1-city-street.png
description: Cover shot: city alive in motion and under pressure along Downtown Avenue. Protagonist Rhea 'Rook' Solano in the foreground on foot with a visible weapon, having just stepped out of an angled stolen sports car at the kerb; street active with moving traffic (taxi, sedan, oncoming hatchback), double-parked delivery hauler, and kerbside muscle car; pedestrians walking in pairs along sidewalks; responding police cruiser with flashing emergency lightbar in the mid-distance; warm late-afternoon sun and vibrant facades; complete HUD with minimap, wanted stars, money, health/armor bars, and mission objective banner.
objective: DELIVER THE STOLEN VELOCE GT TO SAFEHOUSE (140M)

name: 2-car-promenade.png
description: High-speed coastal cruise in a sports car along Ocean Promenade: open turquoise bay waters, sun sinking on horizon, swaying palm trees and cypress grove, pedestrians along the promenade curb, full tactical HUD with speedometer showing 151 MPH and mission waypoint diamond on the radar minimap.

name: 3-police-chase.png
description: Intense 5-star police chase down Skyway Boulevard: player car pursued bumper-to-bumper by police cruisers with blazing red and blue emergency lightbars washing the asphalt and buildings, tactical police chopper overhead with soft transparent amber searchlight beam, elevated expressway structure, and full HUD showing 5 wanted stars and flashing radar blips.

name: 4-dock-heist.png
description: Heist in progress at Meridian Cargo Docks Pier 7: protagonist in foreground visibly armed with a tactical carbine in two-handed ready stance; mid ground features contraband loot crates on wooden pallets with glowing cargo and hovering 3D golden objective beacon, target heist van with rear doors wide open, bollards along the quay lip, and a moored cargo barge in the water; background shows warehouse with roll-up shutter door, colourful multi-tier container stacks, dockside jib crane and 36m gantry crane against the sunset sky, gulls over the water basin, and far shore breakwater; complete HUD with mission banner, wanted stars, minimap, cash, and ammo.
objective: SEIZE THE CONTRABAND CRATES AT PIER 7 (10M)
